boundaries: EVOREC_R06_SERVING_ENABLED defaults to 0; content and ranker backends default to stdlib with no silent fallback
No current business-schema migration/import, active model switch or port-8000 restart
Approved frozen corpus only: no arbitrary new merchant-item model coverage
First interaction is a time proxy, not proven merchant availability; original static text has no historical visibility guarantee
Stored content seal authenticates trusted capture against the approved package, not a cryptographic signature independent of database trust
Full seen includes current-epoch exposure and removed state; explicit history/seen limits reject rather than truncate
Completed recommendations replay saved results; crashed accepted recommendations have no automatic reranking recovery or persisted full eligible-ID set
Background comparisons persist the full frozen input and restore it against the original approved package
Nominal 2-second deadline was not extended; CPU cancellation drains actual work and may confirm later
The measured NumPy historical request is close to the deadline; neither backend choice nor these observations proves stable latency
No network, browser, concurrency/load, cross-process global queue capacity, model eviction or production SLA acceptance
No new research quality/target evaluation, training or generated/hybrid strategy integration
Abrupt process termination may strand a temporary schema; no forced-termination cleanup, fsync or whole-machine reproducibility claim
